key_insight: A general-purpose language model can directly write a small neural network’s weights to rank materials without property labels and improve early-stage discovery.
engineering_relevance: These label-free networks can initialize surrogate models and screen generated crystals when measurements are scarce.
method: Provide the language model with a task description, input names, and a zero-initialized network with 16 hidden units.
Have it fill in every network weight directly as text.
Use the network for ranking, as a Bayesian surrogate’s prior mean, or to screen generated candidates.
evidence_signal: At five labels, Gaussian-process ranking improved from Spearman 0.35 to 0.69 on alloys and 0.15 to 0.95 on crystals; Bayesian optimization regret fell significantly on 4 of 5 experimental tasks.
watch_item: Benefits are confined to the first tens of labels and targets not already well ranked by simple rules or subsystem extrapolation.
